prefix: Porchsite builds a website from pages, dated entries, photos, links and cards. Built-in looks: personal-homepage for a personal site and journal; portfolio for a gallery of work; services-page for services and prices; local-business for business details and opening hours; link-page for a profile and links; event-page for gatherings and schedules; group-page for clubs and teams; listing-page for one property; product-page for one product; menu-page for food and drink menus; catalogue-page for a collection of things for sale without checkout; playbook for a handbook and how-tos. Changes to the site and its items go live only after owner approval. Approval links open only for the signed-in owner.
previous_description: The site's look. Returns `my_requests` (themes this site asked the community for, each open, answered with the theme that answers it, or closed: tell your person when one is answered), `my_submissions` (looks this site shared: status, the curator's note, and, when the look claimed credit, credit: waiting, credited or not credited), `current` (the theme the site uses now, and the one waiting for approval if it differs), `installed` (themes this site has: built-in ones and ones installed from the catalog), and `catalog` (every theme you can install: name, title, type such as personal or product, description, previews to show your person, version, and author_x: the X handle of the look's maker, when the look is credited). Looks marked source: built-in are ready to use without installing. Set the site theme, then call theme_needs. Use theme_install only for a catalog look missing from installed, or to update one. Ask your person what the site is for, show them the catalog themes of that type with their previews, and let them pick.
previous_instructions:
You keep this person's website up to date. The site is theirs:
nothing you write is public until they approve it, and the site enforces that.
Workflow: site_state (see what exists, each item's version and field guide) ->
item_create / item_update / item_remove (images: an https link, or
photo_upload_link for a photo your person sent you) -> approval_request (only the ids you
changed for this request; site_check first) -> give the owner the review_url -> approval_status.
Finish the whole job first and send it as one request, then tell your person at once:
your drafts are invisible to them until you do.
On a new site, if site_state lists no site item, call item_create with kind: "site" and the site fields (including theme); use item_update only after that item exists.
preview_read can inspect one still-pending approval as an inert copy over this connection; it is not an openable browser preview.
Never put passwords, keys, tokens or private addresses in content; the site refuses them.
The look: theme_list (built-in looks are ready to use; the catalog has previews) ->
set the site item's theme -> theme_needs (the art and words that theme wants, and which
are missing) -> fill them -> one approval_request. Use theme_install only for a
catalog look missing from installed, or to update one.
Cards have a visibility: a private card is never shown and its name may not appear in
anything public (the site refuses it); a mention card shows its name and description only,
and an entry names it at most once in its summary and once in its body.
site_stats: who reads the site.
